Mixing Allegra (fexofenadine) with alcohol is ` [Highlight start] generally discouraged [Highlight end] ` , though it carries a lower risk of drowsiness than older allergy medications. Alcohol can still increase side effects like drowsiness, dizziness, and impaired coordination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF16gKYCigyGVb-lyDRUMME-keNwVOJnl8tHxAbzyTTQotAWcO3QkoH-_zPALkAIxKcwrGKoDp31qjxW-8Vchu1NZcJVp7W183TQDxt8MqnA9q2RU5vNiMSYj4rRj9-kXu03fWmS_iqL64j9mNqlUcYrEai_lP7_Hd4X3tEBY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX4XF8IKf1sJ4DKQTqu9BiYOa04IPfk6dsORxlZdrHnEWkh27_B0iq3AM0l3W8qSJeMg9aspXBeDpRa9KUKgZHN5496ButPaOduaSV3-TJQ8xPH76oyqkcRWa8PQMgnu_d4Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXvXa3ua7U_RMy372kh9Ocko3WiXCK-gnwALweUs4g2KQI8iW5E8pe9zW4OxVk-edt8gc1JCE7_FMHvyxeUcJdp_ZCMawZcz4zb2mzEweKEsZK-TH8Whzp9UqwWjSQh98MegaJhHmo)

### Key Risks and Considerations

- **Increased side effects:** Even though Allegra rarely causes sleepiness on its own, combining it with alcohol can make you feel drowsy, dizzy, or less coordinated.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX4XF8IKf1sJ4DKQTqu9BiYOa04IPfk6dsORxlZdrHnEWkh27_B0iq3AM0l3W8qSJeMg9aspXBeDpRa9KUKgZHN5496ButPaOduaSV3-TJQ8xPH76oyqkcRWa8PQMgnu_d4Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXvXa3ua7U_RMy372kh9Ocko3WiXCK-gnwALweUs4g2KQI8iW5E8pe9zW4OxVk-edt8gc1JCE7_FMHvyxeUcJdp_ZCMawZcz4zb2mzEweKEsZK-TH8Whzp9UqwWjSQh98MegaJhHmo)
- **Higher risk with more alcohol:** Heavy drinking makes unwanted side effects and impairment much more likely.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX4XF8IKf1sJ4DKQTqu9BiYOa04IPfk6dsORxlZdrHnEWkh27_B0iq3AM0l3W8qSJeMg9aspXBeDpRa9KUKgZHN5496ButPaOduaSV3-TJQ8xPH76oyqkcRWa8PQMgnu_d4Q)
- **Combination cold/allergy products:** Avoid combining Allegra with multi-symptom cold or sinus medicines that already contain an antihistamine or acetaminophen, especially if you drink alcohol regularly.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX4XF8IKf1sJ4DKQTqu9BiYOa04IPfk6dsORxlZdrHnEWkh27_B0iq3AM0l3W8qSJeMg9aspXBeDpRa9KUKgZHN5496ButPaOduaSV3-TJQ8xPH76oyqkcRWa8PQMgnu_d4Q)
- **Personal health factors:** Older adults, people with liver or kidney issues, or those taking other sedating medications face higher risks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF16gKYCigyGVb-lyDRUMME-keNwVOJnl8tHxAbzyTTQotAWcO3QkoH-_zPALkAIxKcwrGKoDp31qjxW-8Vchu1NZcJVp7W183TQDxt8MqnA9q2RU5vNiMSYj4rRj9-kXu03fWmS_iqL64j9mNqlUcYrEai_lP7_Hd4X3tEBY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX4XF8IKf1sJ4DKQTqu9BiYOa04IPfk6dsORxlZdrHnEWkh27_B0iq3AM0l3W8qSJeMg9aspXBeDpRa9KUKgZHN5496ButPaOduaSV3-TJQ8xPH76oyqkcRWa8PQMgnu_d4Q)

For more details on potential interactions, see [SingleCare](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF16gKYCigyGVb-lyDRUMME-keNwVOJnl8tHxAbzyTTQotAWcO3QkoH-_zPALkAIxKcwrGKoDp31qjxW-8Vchu1NZcJVp7W183TQDxt8MqnA9q2RU5vNiMSYj4rRj9-kXu03fWmS_iqL64j9mNqlUcYrEai_lP7_Hd4X3tEBY) and [Drugs.com](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX7OGPsiCtq-jCpMGntqc-XXv0f5rvo1nhopVAAJlZwoxSzjpLf6v8XlFFwu3DbWBWUVikEUH4hfFZcD34YmAucRLX6hn0q1N6BWTzd6ByYHWhdcfKgD9Ma2uHM1FHSgLp6sOy6ojLSSnPc-YMWmCA6iEwQaUMfn4) . If you choose to drink, keep it light and check with a doctor or pharmacist first, especially if you take other medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX7OGPsiCtq-jCpMGntqc-XXv0f5rvo1nhopVAAJlZwoxSzjpLf6v8XlFFwu3DbWBWUVikEUH4hfFZcD34YmAucRLX6hn0q1N6BWTzd6ByYHWhdcfKgD9Ma2uHM1FHSgLp6sOy6ojLSSnPc-YMWmCA6iEwQaUMfn4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF16gKYCigyGVb-lyDRUMME-keNwVOJnl8tHxAbzyTTQotAWcO3QkoH-_zPALkAIxKcwrGKoDp31qjxW-8Vchu1NZcJVp7W183TQDxt8MqnA9q2RU5vNiMSYj4rRj9-kXu03fWmS_iqL64j9mNqlUcYrEai_lP7_Hd4X3tEBY)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX4XF8IKf1sJ4DKQTqu9BiYOa04IPfk6dsORxlZdrHnEWkh27_B0iq3AM0l3W8qSJeMg9aspXBeDpRa9KUKgZHN5496ButPaOduaSV3-TJQ8xPH76oyqkcRWa8PQMgnu_d4Q)If you'd like more tailored information, let me know:
